resolution.note: Capsule writes replace via temp+rename; closed-claim pruning runs under the task lock. holdTaskLockForTest kept: guarded by NODE_ENV=test plus a hold fd, and the only seam for lock-contention tests.

title: Capsule writes are atomic and claim pruning holds the task lock
body:
Why: Qwen second audit .krn/runs/qwen-research-2/report.md N11, verified at 6d713ae: src/state/write.ts:116,164,298 write capsules with plain writeFileSync (a crash leaves a torn capsule, against docs hardening checklist temp+rename), and pruneClosedClaims in src/task/claims.ts unlinks without withTaskLock.
Outcome: capsule writes go through temp-then-rename (reuse src/task/staged-write.ts); pruning runs under the task lock.
Proof: tests in test/state and test/task.
